EssXmlV1.sections: Exactly one direct meta/work/architecture/design; preserve every section and child order, unknown members represented losslessly, not silently typed away. Missing/duplicate required section is Structure error.
EssXmlV1.representation: Ordered element tree. Element={name:string,attributes:sorted name/value pairs,children:ordered Element|Text|Comment}. No namespaces/DOCTYPE/general entities/processing instructions except UTF8 XML declaration in this profile. Reject unsupported lexical features before partial candidate. Preserve comments in canonical payload; comments excluded semantic projection.
EssXmlV1.strings: All XML attribute and text values remain strings after standard XML character/entity decoding; no generic bool/number conversion. Empty versus missing distinct. Only XML built-in entities/numeric character refs accepted. XML line-ending normalization follows parser; no other trim.
EssXmlV1.whitespace: Ignore whitespace-only text for semantic projection only if parent has element children and every text child is whitespace-only. Mixed-content parent text retained exactly, including spaces/order. Preserve original decoded text in canonical payload.
EssXmlV1.semantic_encoding: UTF8 compact JSON array ["M04-EssXmlV1-semantic-v1", semantic_tree]; recursively sorted attribute names by UTF8 bytes; children order preserved; comments/exact exclusions omitted; no numeric parse of XML strings.

DesignJsonV1.representation: C1 validated complete JSON payload; no XML wrapper or eluslot.esui auto-conversion. Same C1 optional/numeric/unknown/duplicate/resource contract applies.
DesignJsonV1.semantic_encoding: UTF8 compact JSON array ["M04-DesignJsonV1-semantic-v1", sorted semantic JSON]; C1 exact canonical numeric value, recursively sorted object keys by UTF8 bytes, array order retained.
